name: Batonz.Co.,Ltd.
summary: Batonz Co., Ltd. plans, develops and operates an M&A support platform offering business succession matching over the internet in Japan. Services include internet-based M&A matching, management consulting, and website planning and operation, with an M&A Platform covering matching, sourcing and financial adviser support, and M&A SaaS including a customer management system. Incorporated in 2018, it has its headquarters in Chuo, Japan.
